intent: Let a user immediately switch a single setting on or off, applied right away rather than staged for form submit.
avoid_when: the change should wait for an explicit form submit (use checkbox)
there are more than two states
a11y_contract: built on React Aria Switch: `role="switch"`, keyboard toggling and checked-state semantics come for free; visible children become the accessible label, so an icon-only toggle still needs an aria-label
requires_data: a visible label describing the setting being toggled
